summary: Completed comprehensive testing of blog wellness application with new features: Admin panel, Search with tags/filters, SEO Landing pages, and Newsletter campaigns. Fixed critical search API bug during testing.

fixed_during_testing.issue: Required 'q' parameter was mandatory causing 422 errors for category/tags-only filters
fixed_during_testing.impact: Frontend category and tag filters were not working
fixed_during_testing.resolution: Made 'q' parameter optional and added proper handling for filter-only searches

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error with Helmet component for SEO metadata
ui_bugs.error_details: Invariant Violation: Helmet expects a string as a child of <title>
ui_bugs.impact: SEO metadata might not be set correctly

✅ Landing page APIs for all 3 SEO pages (meditation-debutant, sante-chat-senior, zootherapie-bienfaits)
